inputs.text: Hey, get this about Cuba. It's being forced into a rigged political transition from the start, with the locals deliberately kept broke and owning nothing so they can't touch the few businesses left. Meanwhile the wealthy diaspora and foreign investors are all set to grab the property and assets at fire-sale prices. This is no natural or organic shift whatsoever. Hidden elites are coordinating the whole thing behind the scenes to hand it all over to their own circles and anyone with the cash to buy in.
